verdict.rationale: SigNoz presents itself as an OpenTelemetry-native platform for traces, metrics and logs [signoz-docs-29, signoz-probe-1]. Its docs describe exporting telemetry from standard OpenTelemetry libraries over OTLP straight into SigNoz [signoz-docs-23] and instrumenting logs directly with OpenTelemetry SDKs [signoz-docs-6, signoz-docs-31]. Community users independently cite its OpenTelemetry basis as a draw [signoz-comm-6, signoz-comm-19]. Missing for 10: general OTLP ingestion endpoint documentation (gRPC/HTTP ports, auth, collector-less direct export for all signals), since the explicit OTLP export mention comes only from the LLM-observability page.
